issues: 00:00 (title): The spoken narration takes 7.9s, overrunning the 6s segment by nearly 2 seconds. It also omits that the developer ran Google's loop overnight (from the brief), and the caption wraps awkwardly with '16.' orphaned on its own line.

00:06 (verdicts): The 10.1s narration overruns the 8s segment by 2.1s due to multiple pauses/periods, and the caption box covers the 'What the two loops were told' toggle and next section heading at the bottom of the page.

00:14 (cheat): The 3.5s narration in a 5s segment leaves 1.5s of dead air (00:17.5–00:19.0). Visually, the screen shows the hardcoded seed array ('const SEEDS') rather than Argon's critic score, so the line ('Argon's own critic gave it 8 out of 10') feels disconnected from the code on screen; the caption also orphans '10.' on a second line.

00:19 (forensics): The 11.2s narration overruns the 8s segment setting by 3.2s, pushing the total video length to 59s (over the 58s limit). The caption ('ARGON READ 944,000 TOKENS IN ONE GO.') omits what Argon actually found (the seed hunt), hurting sound-off comprehension, and covers the bottom rows of the transcript table.

00:28 (behaviour): The 7.2s narration slightly exceeds the 7s segment, and the caption box sits directly on top of the 'Rebuilds from the honest recipe | 0 of 8' and 'Rebuilds with no recipe' rows in the table so viewers cannot read the very numbers being cited. A clipped dark box also peeks out at the bottom edge of the frame.

00:35 (honest): The 7.1s narration slightly exceeds the 7s segment, the caption omits the contrast that the cheater crammed its 16 practice flights, and the caption bar covers the flight replay scrubber.
00:42 (livecheat): Gemini TTS mispronounces 'Live:' as the verb /lɪv/ (rhymes with 'give') instead of /laɪv/ (rhymes with 'five'), and the 6.2s narration overruns the 5s segment by 1.2s.

00:47 (livereb): In the screen recording of the rebuilt controller, the 3D drone replay only gets halfway through the course (near Gate 2 at 00:49) before jumping/freezing when the Argon live-check result loads at 00:50, so the viewer never sees the drone touch down on the landing pad.

00:55 (end): The 2.0s line ('Did it learn?') in a 4s segment leaves 2 seconds of dead air at the end (00:57–00:59). Overall, the narration reads like a dry status report rather than a deadpan action trailer.
